\chapter{Mathematics layout specimen}
\section{Statements and proof fragments}

\begin{theorem} \label{fixture:thm:add-zero}
  Adding zero preserves a natural number.
  \begin{lean}
    theorem add_zero_specimen (n : Nat) : n + 0 = n := by
  \end{lean}
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
  Apply the defining identity for addition on natural numbers.
  \begin{lean}
    exact Nat.add_zero n
  \end{lean}
\end{proof}

The statement in \cref{fixture:thm:add-zero} also appears in display form:
\begin{align}
  (n + 0) + m      & = n + m, \label{fixture:eq:sum} \\
  \sum_{k=0}^{n} k & = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}. \nonumber
\end{align}

\begin{enumerate}
  \item Displayed mathematics can follow a list item.
        \[
          \begin{aligned}
            \Norm{x+y}^{2}     & = \Norm{x}^{2} + 2\Inner{x}{y} + \Norm{y}^{2}, \\
            \Abs{\Inner{x}{y}} & \leq \Norm{x}\Norm{y}.
          \end{aligned}
        \]
  \item A second item follows the display without losing the list structure.
\end{enumerate}

\noindent
\begin{minipage}{0.65\linewidth}
  Mathematics also fits a narrower text area:
  \[
    \int_{0}^{1} x\,\mathrm{d}x = \frac{1}{2}.
  \]
\end{minipage}

\section{Shared delimiters and structured notation}

Variant Greek letters also work in subscripts:
\[
  \Veps,\quad \Vphi,\quad \Vthe,\quad \Vrho,\quad
  \Vsig,\quad \Vkap,\quad \Vpi,\qquad
  x_{\Vphi} + x_{\Vthe} + x_{\Vrho}.
\]

General-purpose delimiters keep their symbol names:
\[
  \Paren{x},\quad \Brack{x},\quad \Brace{x},\quad
  \Angle{x},\quad \Dbrack{x},\quad \Floor{x},\quad \Ceil{x}.
\]
The standard angle symbol remains available as $\angle ABC$.
Automatic and explicit sizes also apply to double brackets:
\[
  \Dbrack*{\frac{a}{b}},\qquad \Dbrack[\Big]{\frac{a}{b}}.
\]
Structured notation takes separate mathematical arguments:
\[
  \N \subset \Z \subset \Q \subset \R \subset \C,\qquad
  \Brace{1,2,3},\qquad \Set*{x \in \R}{\Abs{x} < 1}.
\]
\[
  (a,b),\quad (a,b],\quad [a,b),\quad [a,b].
\]
\[
  \left[\frac{1}{2},\infty\right),\qquad
    \Bigl(-\infty,\frac{1}{2}\Bigr].
\]
\[
  \Eval{x^{2}}{0}{1} = 1,\qquad
  \Eval*{\frac{x^{3}}{3}}{0}{1} = \frac{1}{3},\qquad
  \Eval[\Big]{x^{2}}{x=1}{} = 1.
\]

The cross-reference \cref{fixture:eq:sum}, the external
\href{https://example.invalid/layout}{layout test link}, and the citation
\cite{layout} exercise distinct link destinations.
